user_story: As a user, I want to set a priority level on a task so that I know what to work on first.

positive.title: Set priority level to 'High' on a new task
steps: Navigate to the task management page.
Enter task details including setting the priority level to 'High'.
positive.expected_result: The task is successfully created with a 'High' priority level, and it is visible on the task list.

negative.title: Attempt to set an invalid priority level on a task
steps: Navigate to the task management page.
Enter task details and attempt to set the priority level to 'InvalidLevel'.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the priority level is invalid, and the task is not saved.

edge.title: Set the priority of a task to each available level in succession and observe execution time
steps: Navigate to the task management page.
Set the priority level to 'Low' and save the task.
Edit the task to change priority to 'Medium' and save.
Edit the task to change priority to 'High' and save.
edge.expected_result: The task priority is updated each time without any errors, and performance remains acceptable with each change taking no more than two seconds.
